title: SARtale Lake Watch - 30-second demo
note: Numbers marked {..} are filled from app/public/data/lakes.json before voicing.

segments.screen: Start screen, then the story's first beat with SUPARCO's quote
segments.text: Pakistan's space agency reported this summer that cloud limited its optical checks of glacial lakes.

segments.screen: Lake Watch list and locator, then one lake's detail and chart
segments.text: NISAR radar sees through cloud. SARtale reads it for eleven lakes in Gilgit-Baltistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: sixty valid looks while the clouds were in, each lake with one plain status.

segments.screen: Print lake brief, then How we know limits, then logo
segments.text: One click prints a brief for the duty officer, limits included. Indicative only; official warnings come from PMD and NDMA. Built on NISAR, open source.
